verifications.claim: SpaceX Falcon 9 launched 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on March 17, 2026 at 9:27 a.m. EDT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'March 17: SpaceX Falcon 9 on the Starlink 10-46 mission with 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station’s Space Launch Complex 40 at 9:27 a.m.'; R3: 'St. Patrick's Day, Tuesday, March 17... SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket will launch 29 Starlink satellites... Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station'
verifications.reasoning: R6 directly matches all details including exact time, date, location, rocket, and satellite count. R3 supports with scheduled details.

verifications.claim: SpaceX Falcon 9 launched 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base on March 16, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Liftoff... Starlink Group 17-24, happened at 10:19:09 p.m. PDT... Space Launch Complex 4 East... Vandenberg Space Force Base... 25 Starlink satellites'; R7: 'Monday, March 16: Starlink 17-24... Deploy 25 Starlink satellites... Space Launch Complex 4E from Vandenberg Space Force Base'
verifications.reasoning: Both R1 and R7 confirm Falcon 9 launch of 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg on March 16 (local PDT time aligns).

verifications.claim: SpaceX Falcon 9 launch on March 16, 2026 from Vandenberg Space Force Base marked over 10,000 satellites launched, according to Spaceflight Now.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SpaceX crossed the threshold of having more than 10,000 Starlink satellites in low Earth orbit simultaneously... Liftoff of the mission that put SpaceX over the 10,000-satellite threshold'; 'October 2025, after SpaceX crossed the threshold of 10,000 Starlink satellites launched to date'
verifications.reasoning: R1 (Spaceflight Now) states the launch marked >10,000 satellites simultaneously in orbit, not launched (launched milestone was October 2025). Claim misattributes 'launched' to this event.

verifications.claim: Multiple additional Starlink missions are scheduled from Vandenberg Space Force Base in late March 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Now targeting Mar 26 at 23:03 UTC... Starlink Group 17-17... Space Launch Complex 4E'; R5: 'March 26 Falcon 9 • Starlink 17-17... SLC-4E, Vandenberg'; R7: 'Friday, March 20: Starlink 17-15... Space Launch Complex 4E from Vandenberg'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm additional Starlink missions from Vandenberg in late March 2026 (e.g., March 20, 26).

verifications.claim: The 12th test flight of the Starship vehicle is expected from Starbase, Texas in April 2026, notes RocketLaunch.org.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '12th test flight of the two-stage Starship launch vehicle. Maiden Flight of Starship V3 Last Update: NET April'
verifications.reasoning: R2 (RocketLaunch.org) directly states '12th test flight... NET April' for Starship, from Starbase (contextual for Starship tests).
